title: toast writing formulas
rule: Confirmation (neutral/positive): optional noun + past-participle -ed + optional prepositional phrase; UI element names in bold. Informational: complete sentence (subject + verb + optional extra). Error: short phrase + in-line action when possible. Keep under 2 lines in English (localization grows).
pass_when: Copy matches the confirmation / informational / error formula; under 2 lines in English; UI names bold on confirmation.
fail_when: Wrong formula for the toast type, or more than 2 lines in English.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
